'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
***[[Islamic extremism|Jihadist]] fighters raid a [[military base]] in [[Madjoari Department]], [[Burkina Faso]], killing eleven soldiers and wounding 24 more. [https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-group-ouagadougou-politics-west-africa-b7cb876b036f646d64227ee55ddf702e (AP)]
*The [[United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations]] agency says that a foreign vessel has been attacked off the coast of [[Al Hudaydah]], [[Yemen]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-united-kingdom-dubai-arab-emirates-7d6930151eeadf58d9d1708dd47762ef (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United States Senate]] votes 86–11 to pass a [[United States dollar|$]]40 billion package aimed at sending aid to [[Ukraine]]. The legislation will head to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] for his signature. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/after-delay-congress-sends-40-billion-ukraine-aid-package-biden-2022-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021–2022 global supply chain crisis]]
**[[2022 United States infant formula shortage]]
***The U.S. Senate votes [[Unanimous consent|unanimously]] to pass the Access to Baby Formula Act, a bill that would provide access to [[Infant formula|baby formula]] in the [[United States]]. This comes a day after the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] passed the bill. The bill will head to President Biden for his signature. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/amp/politics/senate-approves-overhaul-of-baby-formula-rules-in-aid-program (PBS)]
*[[2019–present Sri Lankan economic crisis]]
**[[Sri Lanka]] defaults on its debt for the first time in [[Economic history of Sri Lanka|the country's history]] as it struggles with its worst [[financial crisis]] in more than 70 years. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-61505842 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Fourteen people are killed and 20 others are injured after a bus's brakes malfunction, causing it to crash on a highway in [[Jalisco]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bus-highway-accident-mexicos-jalisco-state-kills-14-emergency-services-2022-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are injured in an [[explosion]] at an [[oil refinery]] in [[Ulsan]], [[South Korea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/eight-hurt-explosion-skoreas-s-oil-refinery-yonhap-2022-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are killed and 10 are missing after a boat carrying migrants sinks off the coast of [[Sfax]], [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/four-migrants-die-10-others-missing-after-migrant-boat-sank-off-tunisian-coast-2022-05-19/ (Reuters)]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The United States [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] (CDC) votes to recommend a third dose of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine]] for children ages 5–11 years old. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/covid-19-vaccine-boosters-cdc-clears-pfizer-for-children-as-young-as-five/ (CBS News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Telangana]]
****[[India]] reports their first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#Sublineages and BA.2 subvariant|Omicron BA.4 variant]] in [[Hyderabad]], [[Telangana]]. [https://www.livemint.com/science/health/omicrons-subvariant-ba-4-detected-in-india-11652966440942.html (''Mint'')]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Spain]] has confirmed the [[diagnose]]s of seven [[monkeypox]] cases, with many others still being tested, amid an unusual outbreak in [[Europe]]. [https://apnews.com/article/health-spain-madrid-portugal-fd2631a5e6c743491f45786874b447f6 (AP)]
**[[Bavarian Nordic]] announces that it will supply the [[Smallpox vaccine#Imvanex|Imvanex]] [[vaccine]] to Europe in response to the monkeypox outbreak. [https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/05/19/2446668/0/en/Bavarian-Nordic-Secures-Vaccine-Order-from-European-Country-After-Confirmed-Monkeypox-Cases.html (GlobeNewswire)]
*[[Polio eradication]]
**A case of wild [[poliovirus]] is recorded in [[Mozambique]] for the first time since 1992. [https://www.africanews.com/2022/05/19/mozambique-detects-polio-case-as-southern-africa-steps-up-immunization/ (AfricaNews)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]], [[Finland–Turkey relations]], [[Sweden–Turkey relations]]
**[[President of Turkey|President]] of [[Turkey]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] reiterates that he will vote against the admittance of [[Finland]] and [[Sweden]] into [[NATO]], effectively preventing their accession. Erdoğan has accused the two countries of supporting the [[Kurdistan Workers Party]] and the Syrian Kurdish [[People's Protection Units]], which Turkey considers to be [[terrorist organizations]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/turkey-told-allies-no-sweden-111446096.html (Yahoo! News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two people are killed and seven wounded during a [[mass shooting]] near a [[McDonald's]] restaurant in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/crime-shootings-chicago-5b8abfd9f6488cecd891d435dcb66a0f (AP)]
*Four people (including the perpetrator) are killed in a [[murder–suicide]] in [[Harris County, Texas|Harris County]], [[Texas]]. [https://abc13.com/spring-texas-murder-suicide-cypresswood-police-activity-quadruple-shooting/11868529/ (KTRK-TV)] [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/houston-texas/crime/article/4-possibly-dead-in-northwest-Harris-County-17184087.php (''The Houston Chronicle'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*An unusually cold spell of weather hits southern [[Brazil]]. A meteorological station in [[Gama, Federal District|Gama]] noted the lowest temperature since the beginning of weather observations (1963) in the [[Federal District (Brazil)|Federal District]], which contains the capital, [[Brasília]], at {{conv|1.4|C|F}}. Several locations in the area have also seen snowfall, which is very rare in the country. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20220520-cold-wave-hits-southern-brazil-with-record-low-temperatures (France 24)]
